messages:
incident-bot: :warning: High-rate auth token reuse detected across multiple regions. Indicator: token-replay-XY12. Primary hit: /v1/embeddings (prod-us-east). Ops dashboard: https://redwood.internal/ops/auth/2468013579
maria.g (on-call): ack — moving thread to #incidents. tagging infra + sec. Is this prod or staging traffic?
trent.s (infra): prod-us-east mostly. ~1.3k token-reuse events in last 15m from two CIDR blocks. Pattern looks like replay rather than retries.
samir (sec): pulling logs. Found token fragments in debug output from svc-log-synchronizer. Saving a redacted sample to secure gist: https://internal.gists/ghi789 — please avoid pasting raw tokens here.
jess (dev): svc-log-synchronizer was a quick debug push last week. I might have promoted a debug tag by mistake. Investigating deploys now.
infra-oncall: I can cordon nodes that ran the image and apply edge deny for suspicious CIDRs. Recommend temporary block for 30m while we triage.
maria.g (on-call): containment plan: 1) remove debug forwarder from prod 2) rotate affected service creds 3) identify customers with auth failures 4) preserve evidence. Owners?
jess (dev): starting rollback: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/svc-log-synchronizer=redwood/svc-log-synchronizer:stable` — rolling update initiated.
infra-oncall: cordoned 4 nodes and applied WAF blocks for 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.0/24. Also adding temporary rate-limit on auth-proxy: `rate-limit auth-proxy 45/m per-ip`.
samir (sec): preparing key rotation. Will revoke exposed tokens and issue minimally-scoped replacements. Revoke example: `redwoodctl auth revoke --token svcacct-99 --reason "leaked-logs-2468013579"`. Pushing new creds to secret manager, will coordinate phased rollout.
trent.s (infra): monitoring update: 5xx auth errors reduced ~65% after rollback + WAF. Still seeing ~150 replay events — looks like persistent clients holding old tokens. Recommend expiring sessions tied to affected creds.
samir (sec): executing targeted batch revoke: `redwoodctl auth batch-revoke --filter "source:svc-log-synchronizer" --parallel 6` — watching for customer impact.
cs-ops: CS watch — two customers reporting elevated 401s (acct-88, acct-9001). CSMs notified privately; no public tickets yet. One customer requested immediate credential replacement.
legal: preserve all original logs and evidence. If any logs were forwarded externally we need to escalate to Privacy. Do not delete or alter evidence.
maria.g (on-call): timeline recorded: 16:03 alert, 16:06 ack, 16:10 rollback start, 16:14 WAF + cordon, 16:22 rotation kickoff. Good pace. Need post-incident owners and checklist.
jess (dev): rollback completed on affected clusters; pods stable on stable image.
infra-oncall: WAF rules active and nodes drained. We'll keep CIDR blocks denied for 1h pending cleanup.
samir (sec): short post-incident action items: - audit CI for accidental tag promotion - ensure loggers redact any token-like strings - rotate all svc-log-synchronizer service keys - add CI gate to block debug images from prod channel - confirm no external log exports. Logging audit results to incident bucket s3://incidents/2468013579/
cs-ops: drafting internal customer notice for review by Legal and Ops: "We detected anomalous authentication attempts affecting a subset of ingestion requests. We mitigated the issue, rotated affected credentials, and are investigating. No confirmed customer data exposure at this time. We'll send a follow-up once analysis completes." :lock:
maria.g (on-call): postmortem owners: jess (deploy controls), samir (rotation + audit), trent.s (monitoring + thresholds), cs-ops (customer comms), legal (notification decision).
pagerbot: Handoff scheduled — night oncall at 00:00 UTC will inherit the incident. Please ensure outstanding actions are tracked in the incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2468013579
maria.g (on-call): containment verified, rotation in progress, no evidence of exfiltration yet. Night oncall @lee please confirm rotation success and any remaining 401s at handoff.
lee (night): ack — I'll pick this up at handoff, confirm key rotation completion and customer follow-ups. :phone:
incident-bot: incident severity set to P2. Channel summary will be auto-posted after the postmortem is filed.
